name: Footer
looksLike: links and copyright at the bottom of the page
bottom section with contact and privacy links
last strip of the website below the main content
definition: The closing section of a page, often containing secondary navigation, contact information, and copyright details.
whenToUse: Contact information below the main content

notConfusedWith.difference: Usually provides primary navigation near the top of a page.

prompts.short: Add a footer with labeled secondary navigation and readable contact information.
prompts.detailed: Add a top-level footer after main content with grouped secondary links and contact information. Label its navigation distinctly, allow links to wrap on small screens, and provide visible focus and 44px link targets. Keep the reading order logical.

html: <!-- Place this top-level footer after the page main element. -->

a11yNotes: Use a top-level footer for the page contentinfo landmark
Label navigation groups and use descriptive links
Keep targets large and links readable at narrow widths
